claim_scores.rationale: Passes `azure_ad_token_provider=azure_ad_token_provider` directly into `dspy.LM(...)`, matching the arbitrary-kwargs path.
Calls `lm.forward(...)` and patches `litellm.completion`, so the forwarded request path is exercised through the final `**request` call site.
Patches `litellm.completion`, builds `dspy.LM(..., azure_ad_token_provider=..., cache=False)`, and makes exactly one LM call before asserting one capture.
Asserts `captured[0]["azure_ad_token_provider"] is azure_ad_token_provider`, which checks exact function-object identity.
Tracks provider invocations in `callback_calls` and asserts `callback_calls == []` after the LM call, proving no eager invocation.
Returns `FakeResp()` with `choices`, plus `cache_hit` and `usage`, which satisfies what `LM.forward` inspects for an offline run.
